name: convo_v5_chat_history
description: v5: S4 history companion (resume a session in the web page)

inputParameters.queryExpression:
(.prev.response.body? // .prev.workflow? // .prev) as $p
| (if ($p | type) == "object" then $p else {} end) as $w
| ((($w.workflowId // "") != "") and $w.status == "COMPLETED"
   and ((($w.correlationId // "") == .sessionId) or (($w.input.sessionId // "") == .sessionId))) as $ok
| {found: $ok, sessionId: .sessionId, history: (if $ok then ($w.output.history // []) else [] end)}
